note: The built core combines this repository's integration with PCSX2 and is distributed under the GPL-3.0-or-later, which is PCSX2's own licence and the strongest term in the package. Everything else it links is permissive or weaker copyleft and travels inside those terms: fmt, imgui, ccc, rapidjson, simpleini and fast_float are MIT-family; libchdr, xbyak, zlib, zstd and lz4 are BSD-family or zlib; the lzma SDK is public domain; SoundTouch is LGPL-2.1 and FreeSurround (with kiss_fft) is GPL-2.0-or-later, both of which the GPL-3 permits. The NAMCO System 246/256 board (waterbox/arcade/) comes from the PCSX2x6 fork and is GPL-3.0-or-later like PCSX2 itself. PCSX2's patch collection (pcsx2_patches) states no licence and is shipped regardless, by the package owner's decision of 2026-10-25, with its authors credited in each patch file. No bios, dongle, disc or boot program is part of this package - a PlayStation 2 needs a dump the user supplies, and it never enters this repository.

components.name: chimera-core-pcsx2 (integration)
components.license: MIT, and PCSX2's terms for patches/

components.name: PCSX2x6 (the NAMCO System 246/256 board)
components.note: The board under waterbox/arcade/ - the JVS I/O board, the ATA/ATAPI drive, the UART to a drive board, the settings SRAM and the board RAM - comes from the PCSX2x6 fork of PCSX2 and carries PCSX2's own licence, which this package already distributes under. Authors to credit: Matias Israelson (El_isra), Tovarichtch, DiscoStarslayer, uyjulian, krHACKen. Nothing new has to be cleared; it is named here because the code is a distinct upstream and should be findable as one. The licence text shipped for it is PCSX2's own COPYING.GPLv3, which is the same GPL-3.0-or-later text the fork carries.

components.name: PCSX2 patch collection (pcsx2_patches)
components.license: none stated: the repository carries no licence file
components.note: The per-game patches upstream PCSX2 ships as patches.zip (widescreen, frame rate, no interlacing, no blur and more), written by the PCSX2 community; each patch file names its authors. Compiled into the core so that each patch is a setting of its game (chimera#371). The repository states no licence; the owner of this package decided on 2026-10-25 to ship it regardless, crediting it here. The file shipped beside it is the collection's own README.

components.name: glslang
components.license: BSD-3-Clause, BSD-2-Clause, MIT and Apache-2.0, with its generated parser under GPL-3.0 with the Bison exception
components.note: The compiler that turns the GLSL PCSX2 writes for its Vulkan renderer into SPIR-V. Its front end and SPIR-V writer are compiled in, without the optimiser and without HLSL. Used only when the Renderer setting is vulkan-hw.

components.name: Vulkan Memory Allocator
components.note: One header, carried in PCSX2's tree (3rdparty/vulkan/include/vk_mem_alloc.h) beside the Khronos Vulkan headers (Apache-2.0 or MIT) it is compiled against.

components.name: AMD FidelityFX Contrast Adaptive Sharpening
components.note: Two shader headers (ffx_a.h, ffx_cas.h) from PCSX2's resources, which its Vulkan renderer includes in the shaders it compiles. Their licence is the comment at the top of each.
